description: Reset button and clock conditioner: it holds the clocks passing through it low for a moment when a reset happens, so every sequencer driven by them gets a rising edge and advances together

params.text: Performs the reset: the clocks passing through are forced low for 100 microseconds and the reset output goes to 10V

inputs.text: A gate here performs the reset; holding the button down does the same thing by hand
Takes a clock to be conditioned; a polyphonic cable is carried through with all of its channels
Takes a clock to be conditioned, one channel only

outputs.text: Repeats the reset gate, at 10V while the reset is held, for passing on to the modules being reset
Carries the clock from the matching input, forced to 0V for 100 microseconds when a reset happens; a polyphonic cable arrives with all of its channels
Carries the clock from the matching input, forced to 0V for 100 microseconds when a reset happens

notes: a clock that is already low when the reset arrives needs no conditioning, so the module makes no difference to it

inputs.0: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
